reason: The plugin is primarily for memory and context continuity, as documented in its README: it stores user/model facts per workspace, makes them durable, and re-injects a bounded set of recent memories into later sessions, while exposing explicit tools to write, list, search, and forget memory entries. This classifies it as a memory-context utility rather than code generation, search, UI, or external-service integration.

summaries.zh: dsh-memory 是 DeepSeek Harness 的记忆插件，用于在同一工作区内跨会话持久保存重要事实，并提供 memory_write、memory_list、memory_search、memory_forget 工具供模型读写与检索。
summaries.en: dsh-memory is a DeepSeek Harness memory plugin that persists workspace-scoped facts across sessions and provides memory_write, memory_list, memory_search, and memory_forget tools for model-driven storage and retrieval.

capabilities: Persist workspace-scoped memory entries across sessions
Expose model-facing tools: memory_write, memory_list, memory_search, memory_forget
Render a bounded memory section into later session prompts
Support configurable limits for stored and returned memory entries
